requested_outcome: Publish and verify a coherent VII finish release that hides impossible holiday periods, adds a useful Holiday Vacation hub, repairs the vacation quick-filter rail, and makes the spa deals slider visually coherent with sharp proportionate media.
authorization_boundary: Source changes, tests, a temporary public candidate, publication and post-publication verification are authorized by the user. No supplier writeback, booking, messaging, DNS, unrelated admin or data migration is authorized.

lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require Heebo-family static and live checks on desktop and 390px mobile.

lesson_bundle.reason: The holiday, filter and spa slider families are primary mobile discovery surfaces.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require 390x844, low-height and responsive transition checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: Holiday periods, quick filters, spa date and party controls are interactive.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise every changed control, invalid state, reload and back behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request explicitly identifies clipped edges, an awkward frame and incoherent slider composition.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require full-page visual inspection, measured geometry and no clipped or stretched media.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A one-day holiday still shows disabled or redundant start, middle or end pills.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Derive visible periods from distinct valid date windows and normalize invalid URL state.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every current holiday is inventoried and Sigd exposes only Whole holiday.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The Holiday Vacation page is decorative or links to stale/generic search instead of real holiday pages.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Build the hub from the same live holiday source and canonical holiday route builder.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The public hub lists upcoming holidays with working canonical links and localized metadata.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The quick-filter bar still looks like a clipped white rectangle at one viewport.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Remove the accidental container panel treatment and verify edge geometry at desktop, tablet and mobile widths.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Screenshots and bounding rectangles show no clipped white semicircles, border fragment or horizontal page overflow.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The spa slider remains two competing tab systems or cards appear detached from the controls.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Establish one grouped slider surface with primary date navigation and quieter party selection.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and mobile inspection shows one coherent section with a single dominant decision at a time.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Spa images are blurred, stretched or crop the subject.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Audit media source resolution and enforce one art-directed aspect ratio and object-fit policy.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every visible spa slider image preserves aspect ratio, covers the frame intentionally and has sufficient source pixels.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Internal labels, disclaimers, exposed native scrollbars, clipped rails or empty bands remain elsewhere on shared public components.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Search all public sources for the reported copy patterns and expand each visual defect to its shared component family.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The attached twelve-image inventory is resolved twice: once in the exact source/component and once in the frozen public release.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The release breaks existing prices, availability, audiences, navigation or card actions.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Record invariants and run focused plus shared-family regression before and after publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Existing functional suites pass and public smoke checks retain price, availability and action behavior.

sources.label: User screenshots for holiday periods and filter rail

midpoint_gate.trigger: The first local rendered slice contains Sigd, the new holiday hub, the vacation filter rail and one spa slider at desktop and 390px.
checks: filter rail has no panel-edge artifact
spa controls and first three card images form one coherent surface

attack_questions: Can an invalid or stale period URL produce an active control or dates that cannot exist?
Does any header, hamburger, footer, breadcrumb or hub link still route Holiday and Dates to generic search?
At any tested width do the quick filters create a clipped background, border fragment or page overflow?
Does any spa slider show duplicate-priority controls or distorted, soft or semantically wrong media?
Did any targeted visual change alter live pricing, availability, audience, action or unrelated page structure?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public release URL, release ID, screenshots, interaction log and HTTP checks.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Holiday route matrix, navigation matrix, filter breakpoint matrix and spa slider placement/card matrix.

effectiveness.baseline: Public release 520 visibly shows redundant holiday period controls and a clipped white quick-filter panel; spa slider coherence and media quality are reported defective.
effectiveness.target: One frozen candidate passes all four changed families without a corrective republish.
